g.text: Reflection times move; the compressed rays converge uniformly

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Dashed lines: limiting wall hits. Dots: interior endpoints. These exact rays are transverse; the theorem also permits glancing limits.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Curves show singular-set geometry, not amplitudes. Proof and all four branches: Exercise 1.
